title: Eval harness: fixtures, objective grader and benchmark layout
description: evals/evals.json schema per the siblings, fixture repositories with a known source of truth, evals/grade.py that re-derives the truth (parses, node cap, accessibility fields, every node in the source, explanation present), and the iteration-N benchmark layout.

acceptanceCriteria.text: evals/grade.py grades a run directory into grading.json with text/passed/evidence expectations, without trusting the agent claims
Each fixture declares its source of truth as data the grader reads
pytest covers the grader on a known-good and a known-bad output
